name: After recital B
title: REPORT on the implementation of the rule of law conditionality regime
part_text: Bb. whereas the individual Member States hold the primary power to legislate and define policy in areas where the EU has either no competence or only a supporting, non-harmonising mandate, such as the structure of national education systems and curricula, the financing and organisation of the welfare state and health services, national defence policy and national foreign policy;
